title: Align the chough-workflow skill with DRIVE-20: route every lifecycle writer through chough subcommands and mark direct specsync change invocation as a recorded direct-native-write violation
description: Align the chough-workflow skill with DRIVE-20: route every lifecycle writer through chough subcommands and mark direct specsync change invocation as a recorded direct-native-write violation
acceptance_criteria: The chough-workflow bundle routes every lifecycle writer through chough: the skill's Drive-the-workflow section states chough-first (chough change new/answer/check/approve/ship, chough stage, chough cases, chough evidence, chough gate) and names direct specsync change calls as recorded direct-native-write violations except for the steps chough does not wrap (review on standing authority, adopt, finalize, ship-status), each shown with its Timeline tracking; the SKILL.md line 'Run HI, SpecSync and Fledge yourself' becomes 'Run HI and Fledge yourself; chough drives SpecSync'; lifecycle.md and plan.md example commands use chough change forms; a repo check keeps the wrapper-only rule discoverable

answers.constraints: DRIVE-20 (agents call only chough to move a change through SpecSync); DRIVE-21 (direct native writes are tracked as direct-native-write Timeline entries, never forbidden outright — the unwrapped steps remain legitimate); the no-em-dashes rule (DRIVE-7) for bundled skill templates; REQ-cli-057/059/061/067/071 name exactly which steps chough already wraps
